description: This Java class provides a custom implementation of a ChooserTargetService for Android's Direct Share feature. It supplies a list of contact-based share targets to the system, each represented with a name, icon, and associated intent component.

classes.name: SampleChooserTargetService
classes.description: Provides a list of contact-based share targets for Android's Direct Share feature by extending ChooserTargetService.

methods.name: onGetChooserTargets
methods.description: Returns a list of ChooserTarget objects representing contacts to share with, based on the matched intent filter.
